ablation.name: vec_sem_region_r4_15ep
ablation.notes: Vectorized semantic region SWD: Q=256 quantile gather, no K×B loop, zero .item() sync. Based on hp_simple_swd12 (simple SWD squared+global + spectral_ode). swd_semantic_mode=region, K=4, blend=0.5. Goal: recover MUSIQ toward WEAVE 54.5 (hp=43.2) while keeping training fast (~20s/ep). bs=128 for VRAM headroom.
